narrative.summary: PoolAddressesProvider.owner() closes into a mutual-pointer EXECUTOR/PayloadsController pair (BGD Labs’ Aave Governance V3), with a real confirmed 1-day per-access-level delay.
narrative.detail: The exact same authority shape as Aave’s Arbitrum and Base deployments below, by design the same official BGD Labs infrastructure reused across every chain Aave governs. A GOVERNANCE_GUARDIAN Safe can veto/cancel payloads outside the normal timelock path. Pushed on-chain 2026-09-20: both emergency committees on this deployment are also tracked on other chains. The PayloadsController.guardian() Safe has 9 signers identical to the guardian committee on Arbitrum, Base, Plasma and Monad, and the PROTOCOL_GUARDIAN Safe (4-of-7, the ACLManager’s EMERGENCY_ADMIN holder) has 7 signers identical to the emergency-admin Safes on the same four chains. The scorer compares each freshly read owner set against a dated snapshot and folds the overlap into crossExposureScore as a flat 80, applied once even though both committees match; no other score moves.
